text.Населённые пункты России: прогноз числен: Russian settlements: population and age-sex forecast
text.Интерактивная картограмма, фильтрация по: Interactive choropleth-style map, filtering by Russian regions and municipalities, population, fertility, mortality, and migration dynamics, settlement profile, age-sex and migration pyramids.
text.Левая ручка задаёт базовый год сравнения: The left handle sets the comparison base year; the right handle sets the last year shown on charts.
text.Сценарий для карты, половозрастной и миг: Scenario for the map, age-sex pyramid, and migration pyramids
text.Список муниципалитетов раскрывается посл: The municipality list opens after one or more Russian regions are selected.
text.Размер окружности отражает классы числен: Circle size reflects population classes; color shows change relative to the base year.
text.На карте показываются только населённые: The map shows only settlements with nonzero population in the selected year.
text.Цвет: прирост численности населения XXXX: Color: population growth in XXXX relative to XXXX
text.Синяя окантовка показывает все опорные п: A blue outline marks all central settlements. The letter inside the circle indicates the type.
text.Щёлкните по окружности на карте или выбе: Click a circle on the map or choose a settlement from the leader table.
text.Фактические переписные значения 1989, 20: Actual census values for 1989, 2002, 2010, and 2021 are separated from forecast trajectories.
text.Нажатие на строку открывает карточку выб: Click a row to open the selected settlement profile.
text.Фактические и прогнозные значения предст: Actual and forecast values are shown separately; forecasts can be compared across both scenarios.
text.Профиль муниципального образования масшт: The municipal profile is scaled to the selected settlement population in the corresponding year.
text.Если выбран год карты до 2021 года, при: If the selected map year is before 2021, synchronization uses 2021 for the pyramid, the first available age-sex profile year.
text.Блок показывает динамику числа рождений: This block shows births and total fertility rate dynamics for the current selection. Actual observations are separated from forecast trajectories.
text.Блок показывает динамику числа умерших и: This block shows deaths and crude death rate dynamics for the current selection. Actual observations are separated from forecast trajectories.
text.Блок показывает динамику притока, оттока: This block shows inflow, outflow, and net migration dynamics for the current selection, plus the age-sex structure of inflow and outflow for the active scenario.
text.Возрастно-половая структура притока и от: The age-sex structure of inflow and outflow is built from the current spatial selection and the active scenario set at the top of the page.
text.Дашборд предназначен для интерактивного: The dashboard supports interactive analysis of settlement-level population and age-sex forecasts for Russia based on the author's projection model. The map displays all settlements with available population and location data. Symbol size is set by fixed population classes, while color shows relative population change compared with the selected base year.
text.Система поддерживает два сценария: вариа: The system supports two scenarios: with migration and without migration. Each settlement time series includes census checkpoints for 1989, 2002, 2010, and 2021 plus a forecast trajectory for 2021-2100. Charts visually separate actual values from forecast series and can show both scenarios at once.
text.Половозрастная пирамида населённого пунк: A settlement age-sex pyramid is built by proportionally transferring the corresponding municipality's age-sex structure to the selected settlement population. The municipal age-sex profile is normalized to total municipal population and then scaled to the analyzed settlement in the selected year.
text.Дополнительно дашборд включает тематичес: The dashboard also includes thematic blocks for fertility, mortality, and migration. Fertility shows births and total fertility rate; mortality shows deaths and crude death rate; migration shows inflow, outflow, and net migration. Migration age-sex pyramids use five-year age groups from municipal inflow and outflow tables aggregated over the current spatial selection.
text.Фильтрация по субъектам РФ и муниципальн: Filtering by Russian regions and municipalities supports multiple selection. After filters are applied, the map automatically fits to displayed points. Settlements with zero population in the selected year are not shown, which makes settlement disappearance visible over time.
